scenes.line1: Which framework fits your next app?
scenes.say: If you're building a web app, picking the right Python framework can make or break your project. Which one should you choose?

scenes.label: FastAPI
scenes.sub: Async-first, automatic docs, and type-driven validation.
scenes.say: FastAPI is async-first, generates docs for you, and uses Python types for validation. It's perfect for modern APIs.

scenes.label: Django
scenes.sub: Full-stack, batteries-included, ORM, admin, and auth.
scenes.say: Django is full-stack. You get an ORM, admin interface, and authentication out of the box. Great for complex apps.

scenes.label: Flask
scenes.sub: Minimal, flexible, ideal for microservices or simple APIs.
scenes.say: Flask is minimal and flexible. It's ideal for microservices or simple APIs, and you add features as you need them.
FastAPI is async by default and runs on ASGI. Django and Flask now support async views, but you can still use sync if you want.

scenes.question: Are Django and Flask strictly sync-only?
scenes.right: No, both support async views since recent versions.
scenes.say: Don't fall for this trap. Django and Flask both support async views now, so they're not strictly synchronous.
